notes: P3: Row (10c-spec §7). tx = -max(0, (index - LEAD) * step), LEAD = 1: cards 0 and 1 both rest at offset 0; card 2 rests at -step.
Shelf offsets: 'offset-N' = focus on card N of row 2 (the first poster row, so step = CARD_W + gap in poster units).
The hold (12 presses at 50 ms) is the retargeting spring test: the trace compares the one bent journey and its rest time (02 §4.3, retarget: true).
Fixture assumption: row 2 is a poster row with >= 16 items so the window [from,to) matters.

states.name: offset-1
states.note: card 1 lit, tx still 0 (LEAD = 1): no slide, the trace must show zero steps or a flat 0

states.name: lead
states.note: card 2 lit: the first slide, tx -> -step; the focused card rests one card in from the left margin

states.name: offset-5
states.note: card 5 lit, tx = -4 * step; the window has advanced past its first page

states.name: hold-right-12
states.note: 12 presses ~50 ms apart from one shell loop: the spring is retargeted, never restarted; rest frame within 16.7 ms; focused card never unmounted (no [focus] loss without a gain)

states.name: left-at-0
states.note: LEFT at card 0 with focusJustMoved not set: the rail opens (the first LEFT after an 800 ms pause); the [focus] table must show no card-to-card move
